about: Every model the editor places and the build lays, each its .glb beside this file: at the origin on the ground, its front along +z, y up, metres. models/README.md says what each field is.

models.label: Cone
models.description: A traffic cone, orange.

models.label: Marker board
models.description: A marker board on a stand: its face toward its heading.

models.label: Light pole
models.description: A light pole, 17 m high, with 2 night lights at its top (Custom Shaders Patch): a flood beam facing forward along its heading and down onto the track, and a spill straight down round it. Its tyres are a tyre stack of its own.

models.label: Tyre stack
models.description: Three tyres stacked, the tyre walls' stack: laid along a curve, a tyre wall.

models.label: Marshal shelter
models.description: A flag marshal's shelter: a white canopy on four poles, braced from its back; its front to the track. Its chair and its cones are objects of their own.

models.label: Chair
models.description: A plain steel chair: its front the way one sits in it.

models.label: Timing table
models.description: A table with two TVs, their screens forward: the session's times and the HotLap Velopark site's page (Custom Shaders Patch displays, as on the table by the hotlap's building).

models.label: Open passage
models.description: A walk-through passage: two side walls under a straight concrete slab, open at its front and its back (one walks through it front to back), 6.4 m across, 7.4 m long.
